environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet. The service runs behind an internal ALB with no request validation. The ECS task role has s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket on * resources. Traffic from internal services can reach any endpoint. No circuit breaker or rate limiting configured. JVM runs with default exception handling - unhandled KotlinNullPointerException propagates as HTTP 500 and crashes the coroutine but Netty keeps the server alive for repeated exploitation.

config.network: Private subnet, internal ALB, no WAF
config.vpc_endpoint: None - S3 access via NAT Gateway
config.restart_policy: ECS service desired count=2, no crash loop detection
